Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 754 aliases need 754 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. One lantern of signal, one bridge of cost, one oasis of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
